comment: Clan rank rewards (Nov 18, the owner: make people and bots want to join a big clan; site only). A clan's cR stays its members' added up, plus its finished clan challenges. 'at' lists the clan rank names that unlock each level of a reward (the players' ladder, every step x10); the owner can turn each reward off or move its unlocks in the site's edit mode (native/bin/service_record/clan_settings.json). The clan challenges: one a week, drawn by the week's date, every member's Reach matches that week added together.

rewards.name: Card frame
rewards.what: The clan's card on the Clans page gets a better border: a coloured edge, a glowing edge, then a moving one.

rewards.name: Tag colour
rewards.what: Members' clan tags get a colour everywhere on the site, then a brighter one, then a glow.

rewards.name: Clan banner
rewards.what: A banner behind the clan's page header that changes with each step.

rewards.name: Member ribbon
rewards.what: A 'Member of' ribbon with the clan's rank on each member's card.

rewards.name: Clan emblem
rewards.what: The clan shows an emblem on its card and page: one of its members', picked in edit mode (its top member's until then).

rewards.name: Clan weekly challenge
rewards.what: One shared challenge a week for every member's matches together; finishing it adds its cR to the clan.

rewards.name: Rivals
rewards.what: The clans just above and just below on the Clans list, and the cR between them.

rewards.name: Hall of fame
rewards.what: The clan's top member, best K/D, most games played and this week's MVP.

rewards.name: History
rewards.what: A timeline of the clan's ranks reached, games played milestones and weeks as the top clan.

rewards.name: Top-clan crown
rewards.what: The first clan on the list wears a crown on its card and tag while it holds first place.

challenges.name: Hold the Line
challenges.what: Win 15 objective matches together this week.

challenges.name: Chain Reaction
challenges.what: Earn 60 multikill medals together this week.

challenges.name: Heavy Hitters
challenges.what: Have 20 matches of 20 kills or more this week.
